Implementation trap found and fixed: axios AxiosError itself exposes numeric 'status' and string 'code' (ERR_BAD_REQUEST), so a naive isApiError guard returned the raw AxiosError unchanged; toApiError now excludes axios errors explicitly before the structural check.

Test-isolation trap: under jsdom a real window.location.href write raises 'Not implemented: navigation' and poisons every later request in the same worker (subsequent axios calls fail with 'Invalid base URL: /login' from whatwg-url). client.test.ts therefore stubs window.location in beforeEach (the AC Context explicitly sanctions Object.defineProperty stubbing).
